newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police arrest Singaporean on drug charge.
newsitem.headline: Thai police arrest Singaporean on drug charge.

text.p: Thai anti-narcotics police said on Wednesday they had arrested a Singaporean on charges of trafficking in cocaine and methamphetamine, known as "ice".

Tan Tiong Heok, 32, was arrested at Bangkok airport late on Tuesday as he was about to board a flight to Jakarta after customs officials found 700 grams (1.54 lb) of cocaine and 1.2 kg (2.65 lb) of "ice" hidden in his jacket.
A customs official said Tan was believed to be a member of a regional drugs gang that used Bangkok as a transit point for trafficking in South American cocaine and China-made "ice".
"The trend of drug addicts in this region using cocaine in place of heroin is on the rise," a customs official said.
Drug traffickers face the death penalty if found guilty in Thailand. But traditionally, the death sentence is commuted to a long jail term.
